languages.coverageRule: Measure availability and fallback per artifact; never infer district-wide parity.

vendor.name: California Department of Education
vendor.basis: Official CDE directory URL keyed by the district CDS entity code.

cadence.expectation: Check before identity or school-roster releases.

sources.archiveNotes: CDE warns that directory details are self-reported and may be stale.

vendor.name: Finalsite
vendor.basis: Official pages and assets identify the Finalsite platform.

cadence.expectation: Monitor only configured high-value pages; do not crawl the whole CMS by default.

sources.archiveNotes: Page URLs and asset revisions can change independently.

vendor.name: Simbli
vendor.basis: Official RCSD meeting source and stable Simbli site identifier.

cadence.expectation: Discover daily; reconcile around each scheduled board meeting.

sources.archiveNotes: Current source. Keep meeting publication state separate from meeting occurrence state.

vendor.name: Diligent
vendor.basis: Legacy RCSD records resolve under the district BoardDocs tenant.

cadence.expectation: Recheck only for reconciliation or backfill.

sources.archiveNotes: Legacy source; attachment links may be more durable than listing navigation.

vendor.name: YouTube
vendor.basis: Official RCSD channel linked by the district and used by the existing pipeline.

cadence.expectation: Discover after meetings and reconcile against the governance portal.

sources.archiveNotes: Recording publication can lag a meeting; video identity must not be inferred from title alone.

vendor.name: Finalsite
vendor.basis: Official budget page is hosted in the district Finalsite site.

cadence.expectation: Check at adopted budget, unaudited actuals, first interim, second interim, and audit milestones.

sources.archiveNotes: Board packets remain a second path for reports not retained on the landing page.

vendor.name: Finalsite
vendor.basis: Board-approved calendar is hosted on the district Finalsite asset domain.

cadence.expectation: Check for a newly approved school year and later revisions.

sources.archiveNotes: A versioned asset URL is evidence for one calendar edition, not a permanent discovery endpoint.

vendor.name: Health-e Pro
vendor.basis: Official RCSD school records point to organization 1184 and the district announced My School Menus.

cadence.expectation: Fetch live for family queries and preserve the retrieval time.

sources.archiveNotes: Menus are operational data and can change after publication; do not present a cached item as guaranteed service.

sourceRegimes.notes: Dates are the first and last BoardDocs meetings currently represented in local data.
The current source continues beyond the observed-through date; null bounds avoid inventing contract dates.

sampleTargets.selection: Meetings spanning BoardDocs and Simbli, including regular and special meetings.
Adopted budget, interim reports, unaudited actuals, and audit where available.
Reconcile source PDF, normalized dates, and generated ICS.
Sample schools with distinct menu identifiers and record live retrieval time.

successSignals: Existing RCSD records can be reproduced from source adapters plus this configuration.
No adapter contains district-name conditionals or editorial district facts.
Every source discrepancy is retained rather than silently overwritten.

openQuestions: Establish official platform cutover dates rather than extrapolating them from the local corpus.
Inventory subordinate governing bodies and define which ones belong in the first reusable contract.
Replace the versioned calendar asset with an official discovery page when one is confirmed.
